title: 21 545,539 persons, 223,129 persons were convicted, 235,837 acquitted or discharged and cases against 86,573 persons were compounded or withdrawn. The all-India percentage of persons convicted to those tried was 48·6 (48·0 of 1957). The States which recorded a higher percentage were Naga Hills & T. Area (74·7), Madhya Pradesh (64·6), Madras (60·7), Delhi (58·8), Andhra Pradesh and Andaman and Nicobar Islands (56·6), Himachal Pradesh (56·1), Tripura (51·0), Bombay and Punjab (50·8) and Uttar Pradesh (50·6). All cities except Bombay also recorded higher percentages.
